## Checklist

- [ ] A test that fails without this change (for a bug: the reproduction)
- [ ] A negative control: the nearest case that must keep working
- [ ] If an input can be absent, damaged or unreadable: a test that it exits 2
      (NOT EVALUABLE), never 0
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (`docs/`, README), and a row in
      `tests/INVARIANTS.md` for a new promise

## Credit

- [ ] Anything adapted from elsewhere is credited in `docs/credits.md`
